name: Gasthof Geierwallihof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Geierwallihof is situated in the historic Rofenhöfe hamlet near Vent in the municipality of Sölden in the Ötztal valley. Perched at around 2,000 metres above sea level at the head of the valley, the traditional inn is surrounded by the high alpine peaks of the Ötztal Alps. Family-run with genuine Tyrolean hospitality, it features comfortable alpine-style guest rooms and a relaxing wellness area with sauna and steam bath. Regional Tyrolean specialities are served in the on-site restaurant. The location provides direct access to scenic hiking trails around the Wildspitze as well as nearby Ötztal ski areas.
